tested: Payment, Invoice with stable items and TripEvidence: failed without Claim -> explicit manual root -> partial revision -> full revision -> confirmation and replay

manual root version conflict preserves type and reason

web.draft_evidence: equivalent evidence IDs remapped, unresolved choices produce an explicit field error and require user reselection; no silent discard
